caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Improve one Go test file through high-value missing tests, correct testify assertions, isolation, edge-case coverage and clear organization, with concrete code-level recommendations.
intent.acceptance: An immutable actual-parent transition makes an existing nonfatal prerequisite assertion fatal before a subsequent dereference/index/type assertion that depends on that exact prerequisite. AST must bind real testify imports, same test/function, same expression and following dependent operation, reject shadowed aliases and already guarded paths. Count independently established failure-containment sites, not all assert-to-require substitutions. Runtime behavior, whole-suite acceptance and broader recommendation quality remain unknown.

evidence.collection: Dependency-free offline replay of original Git Merkle paths, exact public graph responses and independent Go AST analysis.
evidence.authoring: Explicit outcome-informed retrospective refinement after the frozen v1 contract and first native AST pass. Not ex ante, prospective or historical executor certification.
